guide.title: Inspiration Board Template
guide.description: A loose, no-days bucket-list layout for gathering ideas before you've committed to an itinerary — organized by theme instead of by day.

data.text: This one has no day structure on purpose — it's for gathering ideas before you've locked in dates. Group places by theme, replace the "Example:" ones with real finds, then either publish it loose like this or switch the template to Itinerary later once you've picked your days.
